# Casefile v0.7.0

## Added

- Added `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6-luna` to the Codex model catalog and implementation-writer profiles,
  with current model metadata and instructions adapted from their GPT-5.6 counterparts.

## Removed

- Removed `gpt-5.3-codex-spark`, `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.4-mini`, and `gpt-5.2` from the maintained Codex
  model catalog and profile declarations. Live probes on 23 September 2026 rejected all four as
  unsupported with the tested ChatGPT account.
- Removed the requirement to carry Codex Spark when setting up Casefile's Codex integration.

Existing installations receive these catalog changes through Casefile's model-catalog migration
after upgrading. Existing writer bindings are not silently replaced; bindings to removed models
require an explicit choice of a supported model before work can resume.
